Instrumental ambient underscore for loving-kindness meditation. Warm airy synthesizer pads, sparse celesta-like points of light, a gentle upward harmonic feeling like glowing weather balloons crossing a lavender evening. Very slow, tender and spacious; no drums, no vocals, no bass pulse, no dramatic build, no climax. Keep the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Maintain a consistent low intensity, with no intro and no final cadence or fade; the ending should naturally resemble the opening for looping.

Minimal instrumental meditation bed: very sparse felt-piano notes surrounded by soft analog clouds and high, delicate glass harmonics. Leave generous silence and spectral space for a soothing narrator. Make the harmony cyclical so the last moments blend naturally back toward the first.
